context_files.purpose: Verbatim directive prioritizing persistent rigorous paper-level scientific design over engineering activity
Authoritative benchmark, architecture, claim, estimand, promotion, and authority proposal
Exact deterministic CPU v0 FeltCraft-Lifetimes world, target, information, isolation, and falsification contract
Canonical proposed CPU-only authority scope and forbidden transitions

system_thesis_interpretation: The paper-level object is not memory question answering and not whether a LoRA can memorize a finite mapping. It is the causal effect, over a growing within-life public action--outcome history, of representing supported experiential structure in text, graph, or weights and then using bounded local reads plus recurrent composition to take unseen constructive actions. RANDOM is intended as an exact-retention control and MOTIF as a prospective-structure condition; lifetime length, public information growth, representation, access, and interventions are supposed to be separately measured. Organ credit is deliberately narrow: DREAM may search for target-independent hypotheses, later ordinary public outcomes alone may support or contradict them, SLEEP may deterministically transform admitted predicates, the substrate may store or transport them, and reader--THINK may retrieve, compose, and act. A fixed common deck identifies representation/use under identical scheduled experience, not online learning or a flywheel; C4 needs randomized on-policy collection and a separately designed mediation experiment, and C5 needs cross-life operation-policy learning. The negative phase diagram is a legitimate primary result: an explicit graph winning everywhere, compiled text winning while LoRA loses, or no method saturating must remain publishable outcomes. Nothing in the present artifact is empirical evidence. Even a future green CPU bakeoff would establish only that a deterministic instrument is eligible to request a separately reviewed known-good text/model gate; it would not establish post-native development, model usability, compression, transport, causal mediation, online learning, or any scientific claim.
graph_delta_interpretation: N01 and N02 define the proposed causal instrument: matched super-seed quadruplets, append-only public lives, read-only A0/A2/A3/S targets, lifetime-growth quantities, and matched outer-unit estimands. N03 and N04 separate proposal, public support, deterministic compilation, substrate transport, one-atom access, recurrent construction, and resource accounting; this is the right attribution graph in principle, but only if atom/schema grammars and information budgets prevent one nominal predicate or one read from carrying a complete rule set or plan. N05 correctly quarantines the on-policy flywheel and learned LOOP controller from Paper 1. N06 and E07 make authority a graph edge controlled by exact human ratification rather than by validation or model agreement. E01--E06 encode the scientifically necessary order: ordinary public experience enters E; DREAM cannot certify truth; chronological grounding controls admission; text and LoRA receive identical admitted semantic content; a bounded reader feeds recurrent action; and evaluation writes only to disjoint reporting. The graph is conceptual, not yet an exact executable benchmark. The bound files do not fix the RNG/hash algorithm, serializers, complete source schedule, target-deck generator, controller interfaces, semantic predicate grammar, support comparator, MDL codecs, or statistical program. Those choices can alter leakage, entropy, headroom, schema bandwidth, and acceptance, so implementing them after ratification would make unreviewed scientific design decisions. The analytical PCFL-Stream comparator is also named but its exact specification path and hash are absent from the four bound context files. The proposed graph therefore has a sound credit boundary but an incomplete byte-level benchmark boundary.
loop_delta_interpretation: L01 is the only loop that a future exact ratification could release. It must begin by verifying the raw change/context hashes and the canonical six-entry requested scope, run only deterministic local CPU construction and falsification, retain every joint rejection, and stop without a tokenizer, model, provider, adapter, accelerator, remote service, locked split, promotion, or claim. Its output is retain/rework/reject instrument evidence, never automatic entry to L02. L02 is a future fixed-policy THINK loop with one typed operation and at most one local atom per read; L03 is a future target-blind DREAM--later-public-grounding--deterministic-SLEEP loop; L04 is a future common-deck representation/use loop whose disposable targets must have no suffix effect; and L05 reserves randomized on-policy collection/mediation and cross-life LOOP learning for later decisions. The causal order is essential: a time-t proposal must face genuinely later, previously unavailable ordinary evidence before compilation; evaluation outcomes cannot support memory; cumulative rebuilding is within one life from a clean base; every target begins from a sealed cut and dies after scoring. Repetition, additional views, and optimizer steps change search or write strength, not evidential support. At present L01 is not safely executable as an exact scientific protocol because several outcome-determining algorithms and aggregation conventions are left to implementers. L02--L05 are deliberately dormant and must not be treated as validated merely because CPU fixtures exercise their intended schemas or checkers.
claim_delta_interpretation: C0 remains outside this change and requires separately authorized PCFL-13 evidence; conversely PCFL-13 cannot establish lifetime or compression claims. C1 can eventually support only resource-qualified fixed-experience representation/use on the frozen common deck, not equal-compute superiority, online learning, or a general memory advantage. C2 requires actual post-native checkpoints, growth in unique public information rather than token repetition, stable old/new panels, simultaneous interval evidence, old-retention noninferiority, and oracle headroom; absence of detected growth is not saturation. The proposal's alternative monotone-slope route conflicts with AT08's requirement for two interval bounds and creates a claim loophole unless removed or separately registered. C3a requires a schema committed before S, a predeclared atoms-only contrast, a positive simultaneous difference-in-differences bound, at least .10 MOTIF action gain, and an explicit upper/equivalence rule for RANDOM gain. C3b additionally needs a genuinely frozen complete code, including decoder/template, binding, exception, provenance, precision, model-selection, and active-memory costs, at matched loss; action gain alone is not compression. C4 and C5 are dormant higher claims requiring different experiments and cannot inherit common-deck success. The CPU-only claim is negative: it may establish protocol invariants and instrument eligibility, not model or paper conclusions. The phase diagram and organ-credit boundary are scientifically valuable, but a fixed benchmark-designer-supplied motif template can make schema coding artificially cheap unless its description and selection costs are included. Likewise, one later confirming observation is not automatically sufficient support for a broad schema. All claims must fail closed on missing cells, failed predecessors, ambiguous thresholds, or absent authority.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix formally covers all 8 information items across all 7 stages. Its intended policy is defensible: the public collector uses only canonical public history and counter state; DREAM gets only eligible target-blind replay and bounded local memory access; hidden roles, recipes, proofs, rejection state, targets, scores, and authority never reach cognition; grounding/compiler code may inspect lifecycle and provenance but not hidden world truth; THINK sees the current public target and one local atom but cannot browse the lifetime log or global semantic graph; isolated scoring may inspect hidden truth; and future LOOP data contain declassified operation traces rather than outputs, proofs, or scores. Exact audit and authority state remain outside model cognition. However, several information items bundle fields with different permissions, so a single visibility label is not executable. I01 combines goal, state, and outcome although DREAM may receive replay outcomes but no target goal. I03 combines anchors, returned atoms, and workspace although grounding may audit roots but may not treat workspace as evidence. I05 combines the current target with split/evaluation metadata although S05 must see the former and hide the latter. I06 combines atom content, status, provenance, and compiler internals although DREAM may read atom content but not the rest. I07 similarly mixes backend-private computation with model-visible output. These reason strings narrow the labels, but a future implementation can only enforce exact field-level schemas, origin tags, process boundaries, and taint rules. Until those are hash-bound, cartesian-product completeness is structural rather than proof of noninterference.
acceptance_test_interpretation: AT01_change_hash_scope_and_independent_review: the raw change.json SHA-256 is 3f349860ec02a906caff8c735f3c8068e525dfa2bb9a3fd32aa81bef707489dd; the four declared context hashes match the current files; the architecture-change schema, unique IDs, and complete 8 x 7 visibility product validate; state is proposed; and scope_proposal.json contains exactly six sorted requested entries and seven sorted forbidden entries. This proves provenance and proposal-only scope, not scientific adequacy, ratification, or implementation authority. It also does not bind the referenced PCFL-Stream specification. AT02_CPU_capability_firewall: a future implementation must enumerate the full transitive import/call graph and dynamically prove denial before side effects for credentials, sockets/network, remote synchronization, model/tokenizer/embedding/provider loaders, device/CUDA/accelerator discovery and use, adapter/optimizer/weight operations, scientific split access, promotion, and every PCFL-Stream code path. The sole PCFL operation is a read-only analytical comparison against a separately hash-bound existing specification. A green refusal suite is necessary but cannot broaden the six-entry scope. AT03_world_quadruplet_determinism_and_kernel: the intended checks are correct--100--1000 jointly accepted or rejected quadruplets; counter-namespace order/suffix perturbations; replay-byte hashes; tau involution and binding equivariance; exact recipe, inventory, episode-reset, MOVE/GATHER/TRY_CRAFT/STOP behavior; coupled nuisance streams; public-policy equality conditional on identical public histories; and complete rejection receipts. The test is not currently decidable from exact bytes because the counter PRNG/derivation, seed encoding, tau construction, handle/descriptor serializer, iteration order, collector schedule and choice distribution, and rejection algorithms are not bound. Reproducibility requires reruns across processes and permitted platform/version envelopes, not only within one process. AT04_target_collision_headroom_and_leakage: require complete model-visible pre-action byte identity across all four cells per target, identical legal action/candidate sets and budgets, tau-mapped decisive sets, per-target solvability certificates, source/target semantic exclusion, and cohort-level method-blind acceptance. No-memory and exact entropy must condition on the full accepted-deck generation/selection event; otherwise rejection creates a hidden prior. Exact-memory must use only eligible public-source-derived atoms and be distinct from a hidden-world oracle. The present cohort-wide .85/.35 gates, unspecified cohort sizes/weights, undefined brute-force controller, and unspecified probe classes/training splits do not prove every target is solvable or leakage-free. S identifiability also needs a formal posterior certificate showing that earlier and within-era observations identify the missing edge in MOTIF but not RANDOM. AT05_information_growth_MDL_paths_and_resources: unique identified relations, L_enum, L_schema, H_target_no_memory, H_target_source, schema action gain, shortest paths, candidate work, graph work, yields, rejection rates, and CPU resources should be emitted from frozen code at every complete-event cut. CPU evidence can establish absolute information growth and a motif-vs-random structural contrast, but it cannot identify tokenizer-relative L_native cuts. Exact codebooks must include decoder/template selection, bindings, exceptions, provenance, precision, and any active-memory/model-selection costs, with a registered tolerance for matched predictive/action loss. Common schedules do not imply common observed source information when craft outcomes diverge; those realized differences must be reported and either be part of a clearly named total-effect estimand or controlled for before saying compressibility and genuinely new information were varied independently. AT06_evaluation_suffix_noninterference: run-versus-skip tests must clone the exact sealed state and compare all later source, lifecycle, compiler, corpus, memory, RNG, cache, process, file-descriptor, and audit hashes while scanning target goals, queries, reads, paths, actions, outcomes, priorities, and identifiers as canaries. Evaluation must write only to a disjoint reporting namespace, failures remain zero, target processes are destroyed, and neither replacement nor acceptance may depend on evaluation. Test every target position and failure path, not merely one happy path. This can validate CPU isolation fixtures; future model/provider and adapter processes require the same audit anew. AT07_future_representation_transport_and_causal_gates: all listed gates are dormant until new authorizations. The .85/.35 known-good gate, +.10 text-only contrast, .90 atomic fidelity, -.10 LoRA-vs-text noninferiority, four-of-six direct-QA screen, 70%-of-gold DREAM recovery, below-5% unsupported commits, same-corpus contrasts, randomized memory assignment, coherent twin swaps, cited-root masks, and negative masks must be treated as engineering screens unless their denominators, uncertainty rules, data reuse, and exact intervention estimands are preregistered. Four-of-six and point-rate thresholds alone are not confirmatory inference. One-atom/schema grammar must be bandwidth-bounded; same-corpus means semantic atom identity, not equal compute; whole-memory assignment and coherent swaps are primary causal contrasts; cited closure is secondary item-level certification and must cut redundant paths from the identical pre-decision state. A failed predecessor blocks the family or narrows the claim. AT08_estimands_statistics_resources_and_claim_firewall: the matched super-seed q is the outer replication unit; targets, twins, K=2 adapter seeds, and execution seeds are nested observations, not replicates; equal frozen target counts/weights and zero-for-failure are appropriate. C1 requires simultaneous one-sided lower bounds above zero against every named primary baseline plus each observed difference at least .10. C2 must use both registered post-native interval bounds and old-retention margin -.05 unless a separately reviewed alternative replaces them. C3 requires the S difference-in-differences, at least .10 MOTIF gain, an exact no-RANDOM-gain rule, and the complete MDL criterion. Generative and recognition transport are distinct families; causal interventions follow predecessors. But alpha/confidence level, family membership, studentization, multiplier/bootstrap algorithm and repetitions, small-q validity, CI inversion, target weighting, retention contrast, variance-only resizing rule, and power/type-I operating characteristics are absent. A 24--48 cap with many simultaneous binary-outcome contrasts may be incapable of detecting the minimum .10 effect; a blinded variance estimate prevents outcome peeking but does not guarantee power. These must be frozen before confirmation, with simulations of the complete selection, missingness, clustering, and multiplicity pipeline. Resource equality is not established by equal visible bytes, so fixed-resource, efficiency, scaling, saturation, compression, flywheel, learned-policy, priority, and LoRA-superiority language remains gated. AT09_no_automatic_promotion: creating or validating this interpretation changes no authority. Any attempt to implement before exact human ratification, or to move from green CPU evidence to tokenizer/model/provider, LoRA/weights, GPU/remote, locked calibration/confirmation, on-policy work, LOOP training, promotion, or claims, must fail before side effects. Each later transition requires predecessor artifacts, new exact frozen bytes and scope, fresh independent review, and explicit human authorization. A reviewer rejection cannot be overridden by an advocate; repairs require new hash lineage. Failure of any acceptance condition falsifies readiness for the stated next gate rather than being converted into a favorable target filter or post-hoc claim.
assumptions: architecture_change_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the raw current change.json bytes, not a canonicalized semantic digest.
The four context_files in this interpretation are exactly the four context files declared by change.json; mutable intake state is intentionally excluded.
Schema validation and matching hashes establish structural provenance only and do not imply that the proposal is scientifically adequate, human-ratified, or implementation-authorized.

If later ratified, the only executable scope is deterministic local CPU FeltCraft-Lifetimes construction/falsification and read-only analytical PCFL-Stream comparison; all model, tokenizer, weight, accelerator, remote, locked-study, promotion, and claim paths remain inert.
The matched super-seed is the sole replication unit for future confirmation; target observations, twin sides, K=2 adapter seeds, and execution seeds are nested and averaged within it.

An authentic exact-memory controller means a controller restricted to causally eligible atoms recoverable from the legal public source prefix at the sealed cut; a controller reading hidden recipes or bindings is a separately labeled oracle ceiling.
No-memory and entropy calculations are conditioned on every benchmark-generation and joint-acceptance rule known to the evaluator, even though rejection metadata is hidden from an evaluated policy.

Identical experience means identical ordered public source-event bytes for methods within a benchmark cell; it does not mean RANDOM and MOTIF necessarily realize identical public outcomes, nor does it imply equal lifecycle compute or storage across methods.
L_native and the 0.5/1/2/4/8 native-context cuts cannot be measured during the proposed CPU-only scope because scientific tokenizer/model execution is explicitly forbidden.

A passing CPU fixture for a future reader, compiler, causal checker, or isolation boundary is checker conformance only; scientific credit requires repeating the frozen test on actual later model-backed executions under new authority.

ambiguities.question: Which exact counter-based PRNG, tuple encoding, hash/key derivation, integer sampling rule, namespace strings, tau construction, ordering rules, Unicode normalization, serializer, and implementation/version envelope define bit-deterministic quadruplets?
ambiguities.impact: The contract names counter namespaces and UTF-8 bytes but does not bind the algorithms that produce them. Different legitimate implementations yield different worlds, target collisions, and rejection rates, so AT03 cannot currently certify cross-run exactness.

ambiguities.question: What exact era/episode schedule, collector action distribution, stopping rules, number of eras, target-template generator, cohort sizes, target repetitions, budgets, candidate inventories, and all-or-reject grouping instantiate A0/A2/A3/S?
ambiguities.impact: These choices determine which relations become public, whether S is identifiable, brute-force success, path length, lifetime growth, target weighting, and power. Leaving them to implementation makes AT03--AT05 and AT08 non-reproducible scientific design.

ambiguities.question: What exact typed grammar, maximum serialized size, allowed constants/variables/quantifiers, scope language, procedure/schema payload, shortcut payload, anchor, reader return, Z budget, and operation budget define one proposal, one predicate, and one atom?
ambiguities.impact: A nominally single predicate or atom can encode an entire recipe table, solver, or plan. Without a frozen semantic and bit budget, one-atom access and one-edge compilation do not prevent an answer-bearing side channel or support fair text/graph/LoRA comparison.

ambiguities.question: For each relation, procedure, shortcut, and schema scope, how many independent roots and later predictions are required; what counts as a match, contradiction, revocation, revision, or separating observation; and may one outcome support a universal schema?
ambiguities.impact: The current comparator can support a broad claim after an unspecified later outcome. False or overbroad schemas could enter SLEEP while satisfying chronology, confounding DREAM proposal quality, compiler value, and schema precision.

ambiguities.question: What exact prior and conditioning sigma-field define H_target_no_memory and H_target_source after joint quadruplet generation, cohort-level rejection, headroom filters, leakage filters, and visible target fields?
ambiguities.impact: Selection can correlate visible templates with hidden bindings. An entropy or no-memory controller that ignores the accepted-deck event can understate leakage and overstate lifetime information value.

ambiguities.question: What exact observations, eligible atom set, query interface, action horizon, computation bound, tie-breaking, and randomness are granted separately to no-memory, brute-force, observed-atom, explicit-schema, exact-memory, and hidden-oracle controllers?
ambiguities.impact: The named controllers range from information-theoretic ceilings to interface-constrained policies. Without separate frozen contracts, .85/.35 headroom can be obtained or lost by changing access rather than benchmark information.

ambiguities.question: What exact prefix-free encoders/decoders and units define L_enum and L_schema, including template ID and selection, decoder cost, permutation, bindings, exceptions, provenance, precision, rejected schemas, and active-memory overhead, and what tolerance defines matched predictive/action loss?
ambiguities.impact: The registered motif is designer-known and can appear compressive if its description/selection cost is omitted. Different reasonable codecs or loss tolerances can reverse C3b.

ambiguities.question: What alpha/confidence level, exact primary baseline set, family ordering, contrast vector, target weighting, studentization, multiplier/bootstrap distribution and repetitions, null centering, confidence-bound inversion, finite-sample correction, and variance-only sample-size simulation are frozen?
ambiguities.impact: Simultaneous lower bounds and Romano--Wolf are labels rather than a reproducible decision rule until these are fixed. With only 24--48 outer units, calibration and power for a .10 minimum effect are otherwise unknown.

ambiguities.question: Is C2 earned only when both 2L-to-4L and 4L-to-8L simultaneous lower bounds exceed .02, as AT08 implies, or can the alternative monotone repeated-measures slope suffice, and exactly which old panel/cut/reference defines the -.05 retention contrast?
ambiguities.impact: The current alternatives can yield a continued-improvement claim despite a failed interval, and the noninferiority comparison cannot be computed uniquely.

ambiguities.question: What exact upper-bound, equivalence, or noninferiority criterion defines no spurious RANDOM schema gain, and is it applied to the point difference, a simultaneous interval, or a conditional entropy/action contrast?
ambiguities.impact: A positive difference-in-differences plus .10 MOTIF gain can still coexist with a scientifically important RANDOM gain. The prose requires its absence but provides no fail-closed threshold.

ambiguities.question: Are .85 oracle/exact-memory and .35 no-memory/brute/leakage thresholds required per target, per stratum, per super-seed, or only after pooling a cohort, and why may an exact deterministic oracle fail on up to 15% of accepted targets?
ambiguities.impact: Cohort-only thresholds can retain impossible or leaked targets whose composition differs by stratum and drives method effects. Per-target solvability and aggregation rules are needed for a constructive benchmark.

ambiguities.question: Which future action model, tokenizer, prompt, state serializer, workspace allowance, operation-history allowance, output reserve, truncation policy, and nearest-complete-event tie rule define L_native and the five cuts?
ambiguities.impact: Post-native development and the 1.8x interval requirements are model-relative. CPU-only absolute cuts cannot later be relabeled native without a new exact authorization.

ambiguities.question: What classifiers or exact enumerators, features, train/DEV/test splits, hyperparameter budgets, multiplicity correction, seeds, and confidence rule define target-only, state-only, identifier, descriptor, action-frequency, and passive probes?
ambiguities.impact: A weak probe scoring below .35 does not show absence of leakage. Outcome-conditioned probe selection or reuse could also turn a diagnostic into a benchmark filter.

ambiguities.question: At what randomization unit and time are whole-memory nulls, cross-life assignments, twin swaps, schema shuffles, cited-root masks, and negative masks applied, and how are at-least-half-the-gain or .15 absolute effects aggregated when gains are small, negative, or supported by redundant paths?
ambiguities.impact: Different interventions test availability, content binding, retrieval, or composition. Without exact estimands and exclusion checks, an action change may reflect distribution shift or broken interfaces rather than memory-mediated reasoning.

ambiguities.question: Which lifecycle resource quantities are constraints versus descriptive covariates, what hardware/concurrency/warm-cache protocol applies, and what resource envelope qualifies any C1 or phase-diagram comparison?
ambiguities.impact: The proposal correctly rejects false equal-compute language, but an unqualified method improvement may still be purchased by unbounded training, search, candidates, or external memory.

ambiguities.question: What field-level schemas split current targets from split metadata, replay outcomes from target goals, atom content from status/provenance, cited roots from workspace text, and backend-private candidate work from model-visible returns?
ambiguities.impact: Several matrix cells assign one label to a bundled information item while their reason grants different permissions to subfields. Implementers cannot enforce this safely without exact partitions and origin tags.

ambiguities.question: What precise legal-prefix evidence and within-era observations are available for S, and how is the posterior over the missing decisive edge computed under the permutation constraint in RANDOM and MOTIF?
ambiguities.impact: Observed edges within a RANDOM era can constrain or determine the remaining role by elimination. The intended MOTIF-only schema advantage must be proved for the actual target state, not asserted from regime labels.

ambiguities.question: Which exact existing PCFL-Stream specification, version, path, and SHA-256 is the sole input to the authorized analytical comparison, and what predeclared comparison criteria select retain, rework, reject, or a fallback request?
ambiguities.impact: PCFL-Stream analysis is in requested scope but no PCFL-Stream file is context-bound. Choosing a comparator or decision rubric after CPU results permits fallback drift and violates exact-byte authority.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The four bound context files do not yet specify an exact executable CPU benchmark, despite repeatedly calling world_contract.md exact.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Outcome-determining bytes for generation, serialization, schedules, targets, controllers, schemas, codecs, probes, and statistics are absent. Validation can confirm the prose hash but cannot prevent implementers from selecting scientific behavior after ratification.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before implementation authority, bind machine-readable world/controller/deck/schema/codec/statistics manifests and golden cases in a successor reviewed change, or narrow the first scope to producing those proposal bytes for a second human decision without running benchmark evidence.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: One predicate per compiler view and one atom per reader return are not meaningful anti-shortcut constraints without a frozen semantic grammar and bit budget.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A single schema or procedure field can encode the complete mapping or an answer-bearing plan while formally remaining one predicate. This would let compilation or retrieval perform the reasoning attributed to recurrent THINK.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze typed local atom/schema grammars, maximum serialized bits, variable/scope rules, forbidden target-bearing fields, Z and operation budgets, and adversarial bandwidth tests before any model-backed gate.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Chronological later evidence is necessary but not sufficient to certify a broad DREAM proposal, and the current contract does not bind adequate support multiplicity or separating tests.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: One later success can mechanically mark an overbroad schema SUPPORTED. The compiler would then transport a false generalization, while the pipeline could still over-credit DREAM or SLEEP until sparse evaluation reveals it.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Register predicate-specific support rules, independent-root requirements, separating positive/negative panels, scope refinement and revocation rules, and prospective precision intervals; keep any claim provisional until its exact rule passes.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: AT08 is directionally sound but not a complete confirmatory analysis plan, and the fixed range of 24--48 outer units has no demonstrated power or calibration.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Alpha, families, baseline membership, contrast weights, bootstrap details, interval inversion, missingness/selection simulation, and resizing rules are unspecified. Studentized multiplier/bootstrap inference can be inaccurate with 24 clusters and many binary contrasts; an observed .10 threshold does not repair type-I error or low power.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze executable estimator code and complete simulation-based operating characteristics under the exact clustered selection/missingness process before confirmation; increase or abandon the cap if the preregistered minimum effect cannot be detected with controlled familywise error.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal's monotone repeated-measures slope alternative should not earn C2 when either registered post-native interval fails its lower-bound requirement.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A positive overall slope can coexist with a flat or negative 4L-to-8L interval. That would not support continued acquisition across both claimed intervals and contradicts AT08's explicit two-bound language.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require both simultaneous interval lower bounds plus old-retention noninferiority for C2; report the slope descriptively, or submit a successor change that defines a different claim and multiplicity family.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: C3a can currently pass without a formal demonstration that RANDOM has no schema gain, and C3b can pass under a benchmark-favored incomplete code.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A positive DiD constrains relative gain, not the absolute RANDOM gain demanded by the claim. L_schema < L_enum is uninterpretable unless complete decoder/template selection/provenance/precision and matched-loss costs are included.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add a simultaneous upper/equivalence bound for RANDOM schema gain and bind complete prefix-free codecs plus matched-loss tolerances, including the fixed template's description and selection costs.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A deterministic constructive benchmark should not accept a cohort merely because exact memory or a hidden oracle averages .85, allowing up to 15% impossible or misbudgeted targets.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Impossible items are guaranteed zeros and can be unevenly distributed across strata or interact with method failures. Cohort means also conceal individual target leakage above .35.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require a per-target hidden-oracle solvability/path certificate and a separately defined per-target or tightly stratified authentic-memory headroom rule; retain cohort aggregates only as summaries.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Sharing source schedules and nuisance draws does not independently vary compressibility while holding realized public information fixed, because binding changes craft outcomes and therefore later public histories and identified relations.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The source collector is public-history dependent. Once outcomes differ, later actions and exposure may diverge, so RANDOM/MOTIF differences can include information yield and trajectory effects in addition to cross-era compressibility. This conflicts with the stated independent variation unless the total effect is explicitly intended.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define the regime contrast as a total effect and report the full mediation through realized experience, or construct/condition matched public-information panels and compare schema versus atoms within those panels. Do not claim independent manipulation merely from shared RNG namespaces.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: No-memory, entropy, and leakage checks are invalid if they ignore information induced by joint headroom and structural acceptance.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Even method-blind rejection can correlate visible target fields with hidden answers. Hiding the rejection receipt from the policy does not remove the public knowledge that all evaluated decks passed the registered acceptance rule.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Compute exact posteriors conditional on the complete accepted-deck algorithm and audit target-only Bayes performance under that distribution; freeze rejection before methods and report all yields.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The four-of-six transport rule, 70%-of-gold DREAM rule, below-5% unsupported rate, and point causal thresholds cannot by themselves support confirmatory organ claims.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Their denominators, uncertainty, data reuse, and multiplicity are unspecified, and tiny pair counts admit noisy passage. Scripted CPU interventions validate checkers rather than actual model mediation.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Label these disposable gates as engineering filters only; before claims, freeze outer-unit estimands, simultaneous confidence rules, independent data, model-state intervention procedures, and failure handling.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The visibility matrix is formally complete but several cells are semantically contradictory because one information item contains both visible and forbidden subfields.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: For example, S05 must see the current target while hiding split/evaluation metadata, and DREAM may see replay outcomes or atom content while hiding goals, status, and provenance. A single hidden/visible label cannot encode these boundaries.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Split bundled information items into field-level types, bind exact input/output schemas and origin tags, regenerate the full product, and mechanically taint-test every stage.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The authorized analytical PCFL-Stream comparison is not exact-byte scoped because no PCFL-Stream specification or decision rubric is among the bound contexts.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A later analyst could choose the comparison version or interpretive criteria after seeing FeltCraft evidence. That is both an authority ambiguity and a benchmark-selection degree of freedom.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add the exact read-only PCFL-Stream specification path/hash and a predeclared analytical comparison/decision table to the successor change; continue to forbid implementation unless separately reviewed.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The fixed eight-role/four-recipe motif cannot support a compression claim if its designer-supplied template and selection costs are treated as free.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: L_schema can be shorter by construction because the benchmark exposes one privileged grammar. That shows compression relative to a supplied code, not necessarily that the agent discovered a shorter experiential representation.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Charge a complete universal or preregistered model-class code including template identification/selection, compare against alternative motif learners, and distinguish oracle-code compressibility from learned DREAM compression.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Changing behavior after a root mask or twin substitution is not sufficient evidence that the cited memory caused correct composition.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The intervention can create malformed or out-of-distribution inputs, alter resource use, or leave uncited redundant paths. Conversely, a correct action can survive because the model uses an uncited memory route. The proposed half-gain/.15 rule does not resolve these cases.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Fork the exact sealed pre-decision state, change only registered semantic content with type/length/resource-matched controls, cut the transitive closure of all redundant paths, verify parser and retrieval invariants, and score registered twin-valid action changes separately from generic performance loss.
